slides.headline: 3 MOVES FORD MADE WHEN ITS EV BET LOST 80%
slides.kicker: 3 CEO moves when a bet dies

caption:
Ford's EV bet just lost 80% in one quarter. The F-150 Lightning is dead. Here's the CEO playbook when your biggest bet starts dying. 📉

1) THE KILL. The F-150 Lightning: 289 units in Q3. Not 2,000. 289. Below the minimum units where a product earns its keep, keeping it on sale was hurting Ford's name more than the money coming in. Ford cut it. Most CEOs wait 12 months past that number.

2) THE HOLD. Mach-E: 5,574 units, down 72%, still running. Ford kept it. Two failing lines need two different decisions. One gets killed fast. The other gets everything you have.

3) THE READ. Ford's Q3 numbers were already written in Q1. Two straight quarters where your best truck sold fewer units each month is the 90-day warning. Pull your unit numbers by product line tonight.

SAVE THIS: the 80% floor CEO playbook.

Ford is the loudest data point right now: companies that bet on AI in 2024 are gaining, companies that bet on EVs are explaining 289-unit quarters to their boards. The bet you make this quarter is in your 2027 numbers.

Running a business? DM us "AI" and we'll show you what this could do for yours.

Sources: Ford Motor Company Q3 2026 U.S. sales
